newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Oct manufacturing up 13.8 pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Oct manufacturing up 13.8 pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: The sales value of Malaysian manufacturing sector's output in October rose by 13.8 percent to 15.7 billion ringgit over the same period last year, the Statistics Department said in its monthly report.
However, the output was 1.3 percent lower than in September this year, the department was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.
The department's figures were based on a survey of 58 of the 137 manufacturing industries, it said.
It said the 58 industries reported a total sales value of 148.4 billion ringgit for the first 10 months of the year, up 13.9 percent over the year-ago period.
However, 29 industries contributed about 89.8 percent of the total sales value.

They included semi-conductors, electronic components and communication equipment, radio and television sets, audio equipment, crude oil refineries, motor vehicles and office equipment and computer industries.
